title: nb: verdict and status-event edge cases reported in the spec review (unverified)
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

Reported by reviewers; not re-checked.

- `nb verdict` works on a result of an abandoned experiment and changes the hypothesis.
- Two status events in the same second: a `confirm --also` beats a later verdict, and verdicts from different experiments order by experiment id. SPEC gives no rule for ties across lists.
- `confirm --also` sets the hypothesis status directly without `recompute`.
- Two `--verdict` for one hypothesis in one `nb result` are refused with the replacement message, not the duplicate one.
